body:
I've debugged and tracked down the issue to a function call triggered by a file being reloaded from disk. Specifically, when there are external changes to a file, Godot by default automatically reloads all open scripts by calling the `reload_scripts` method on ScriptEditor, which eventually leads to the full contents of the text editor being cleared before being restored with the new file contents, losing the Godot-stored stored breakpoints in the process. I attached the call stack below.

<details>
<summary>Call stack</summary>

```cpp
TextEdit::Text::remove_range(int, int) (/home/soul/tools/godot/scene/gui/text_edit.cpp:564)
TextEdit::_base_remove_text(int, int, int, int) (/home/soul/tools/godot/scene/gui/text_edit.cpp:9288)
TextEdit::_remove_text(int, int, int, int) (/home/soul/tools/godot/scene/gui/text_edit.cpp:9175)
TextEdit::_set_text(String const&, bool) (/home/soul/tools/godot/scene/gui/text_edit.cpp:3993)
TextEdit::set_text(String const&) (/home/soul/tools/godot/scene/gui/text_edit.cpp:4022)
TextEditorBase::reload_text() (/home/soul/tools/godot/editor/script/script_editor_base.cpp:590)
ScriptEditor::_reload_scripts(bool) (/home/soul/tools/godot/editor/script/script_editor_plugin.cpp:2548)
ScriptEditor::reload_scripts(bool) (/home/soul/tools/godot/editor/script/script_editor_plugin.cpp:2496)
ScriptEditor::_test_script_times_on_disk(Ref<Resource>) (/home/soul/tools/godot/editor/script/script_editor_plugin.cpp:840)
ScriptEditor::_notification(int) (/home/soul/tools/godot/editor/script/script_editor_plugin.cpp:1560)
ScriptEditor::_notification_forwardv(int) (/home/soul/tools/godot/editor/script/script_editor_plugin.h:84)
```

</details>

I am new to contributing to Godot, so I'm still thinking about the right way to fix it. I will update here soon when I get the chance to look deeper into it.
